name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Technician, Cortex, and Plankton belong to different colonists.
Plankton goes with either Okafor or Cortex (but not both).
Plankton goes with exactly two of Fontaine, Forge, and Ganymede.
Medic, Ganymede, and Regolith belong to different colonists.
Venus goes with none of Fontaine, Technician, or Plankton.
